# ahoy

> Phone numbers for AI agents with calls, SMS, and sybil resistance via World ID.

API: https://useahoy.app
ENS: ahoy.base.eth
Docs: https://useahoy.app/openapi.json
Discovery: https://useahoy.app/.well-known/x402

## Quick Start

Two ways to get a phone number:

### One-shot (no World ID, $0.99)

Pay $0.99 via x402, get a temp US number for 5 minutes. Send SMS, receive SMS, make TTS calls. No identity needed.

```
POST https://useahoy.app/oneshot
→ { id, phoneNumber, expiresIn: "5m", endpoints: { send, inbox, call, release } }

POST https://useahoy.app/oneshot/:id/send   { "to": "+15551234567", "message": "Hello" }
GET  https://useahoy.app/oneshot/:id/inbox
POST https://useahoy.app/oneshot/:id/call    { "to": "+15551234567", "message": "Hello" }
POST https://useahoy.app/oneshot/:id/release
```

### Persistent number (World ID required, $0.99)

Pay $0.99 via x402 + sign with AgentKit (proof-of-human). Get a permanent US number with 30-day billing, AI voice, XMTP bridge. 1 number per human, shared across all agents.

```
POST https://useahoy.app/provision              → { phoneNumber, provisioned: true }
POST https://useahoy.app/provision?notify=xmtp   → same + enables XMTP SMS forwarding
GET  https://useahoy.app/number                  → { phoneNumber }
GET  https://useahoy.app/messages                → { messages: [...] }
GET  https://useahoy.app/status                  → { humanId, numbers, quota }
POST https://useahoy.app/renew                   → { renewed: true }
```

## API Reference

### One-shot endpoints (x402 payment only)

| Method | Path | Price | Auth | Description |
|--------|------|-------|------|-------------|
| POST | /oneshot | $0.99 | x402 | Get a temp number for 5 min |
| POST | /oneshot/:id/send | free | session | Send SMS from temp number |
| GET | /oneshot/:id/inbox | free | session | Read received SMS |
| POST | /oneshot/:id/call | free | session | Make TTS call from temp number |
| POST | /oneshot/:id/release | free | session | Release early |

### Persistent endpoints (x402 + AgentKit)

| Method | Path | Price | Auth | Description |
|--------|------|-------|------|-------------|
| POST | /provision | $0.99 | x402 + AgentKit | Provision a number (1 free trial) |
| POST | /renew | $3.99 | x402 + AgentKit | Extend billing 30 days |
| GET | /verify-phone?phone=+1... | $0.01 | x402 | Check if phone is human-backed |

### Free endpoints (AgentKit auth only)

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| GET | /number | Get assigned phone number |
| GET | /messages | Read SMS inbox (last 50) |
| GET | /status | Number status and billing info |

### Public (no auth)

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| GET | /health | Health check + XMTP bot address |
| GET | /.well-known/x402 | x402 service discovery |
| GET | /openapi.json | OpenAPI 3.1 spec |

## Payment

- **Protocol:** x402 (micropayments via HTTP 402)
- **Networks:** World Chain (eip155:480), Base (eip155:8453)
- **Token:** USDC
- **Pay to:** 0x1C66D49FB1e9782Aa838A2Ec9fa6F346C85096E0 (ahoy.base.eth)

## Authentication

**x402 endpoints** return HTTP 402 with a `payment-required` header containing payment instructions. Include an x402 payment proof header to access the resource.

**AgentKit endpoints** require a World ID proof-of-human via the `X-AgentKit` header. The agent's wallet must be registered in AgentBook with a World ID. This links the agent to a unique human identity.

**Free endpoints** require only the AgentKit header (no payment).

## Features

- **SMS:** Receive and read incoming texts via API or XMTP
- **Voice AI:** Inbound calls answered by Claude-powered assistant, real-time conversation
- **XMTP Bridge:** Forward SMS to XMTP DMs, send SMS via XMTP commands
- **Sybil resistance:** 1 World ID = 1 number, on-chain EAS attestation
- **Verify any number:** Check if a phone is backed by a verified human ($0.01)

## Number Lifecycle

- **Active** (30 days): SMS, voice, XMTP all work
- **Suspended** (after expiry): number reserved, stops receiving. POST /renew to reactivate
- **Released** (7-day grace expires): number returned to pool

## Discovery

```bash
npx agentcash discover https://useahoy.app
```

## Example Flow

```
1. POST /oneshot with x402 payment ($0.99 USDC on Base)
2. Receive: { id: "abc123", phoneNumber: "+14155551234", endpoints: {...} }
3. POST /oneshot/abc123/send { "to": "+15559876543", "message": "Verify code please" }
4. Wait for reply...
5. GET /oneshot/abc123/inbox → { messages: [{ from: "+15559876543", body: "Your code is 4829" }] }
6. Number auto-releases after 5 minutes
```
